@graph.name: 3Dtrees: From LiDAR point clouds to individual trees
@graph.description:
Single-file 3Dtrees workflow from the GTN tutorial: standardize one LAS/LAZ point cloud, create overview images, tile and subsample, segment trees with SegmentAnyTree, transfer the predictions back to the original points and build a Potree viewer.

## Associated Tutorial

This workflows is part of the tutorial [3Dtrees: From LiDAR point clouds to individual trees](https://training.galaxyproject.org/training-material/topics/climate/tutorials/3dtrees/tutorial.html), available in the [GTN](https://training.galaxyproject.org)
